Monsoon Activity Expected in Parts of India, Clear Skies Elsewhere

Parts of Madhya Pradesh, including Gwalior-Chambal and Vindhya regions, are forecast to experience rain with thunder and lightning across 20 districts. In contrast, Bhopal and Indore are expected to have clear weather. Meanwhile, in Bihar, the weather is predicted to remain clear, with temperatures rising in Patna and 20 other districts, though a cooling effect is anticipated in the mornings and evenings. Kanpur is expected to see increased humidity amidst strong sunshine, with clear skies and relief from the evening through morning.
